svg.text: Top row: one issue from dispatch to PR. Bottom row: after the merge. Every step is explained below.

g.text: Once the daemon has built the worktree and copied the files in COPY_TO_WORKTREE, it runs this command there.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: For installing dependencies; a failure is only logged and dispatch goes on. Set it to : if not needed.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: On every dispatch the daemon joins the tool's template, the lessons and the project's <name>.extra.md,

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: then appends sections by switch. The project layer wins on conflict; a full override misses tool updates.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: After opening the PR and flipping labels, the worker runs this script as its prompt says; the daemon never calls it.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: It gets PR, ISSUE, WORKTREE, BRANCH, REPO, PROJECT_ROOT; typical use: deploy a preview build, post a QR code.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Only with LABEL_PENDING_REVIEW set: another agent reviews with the tool's review template plus review.extra.md.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Fail: back to the worker. Pass: to the human; on autopilot, design to build, code to the merge check.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: When the daemon sees a newly merged PR it cleans up (AUTO_CLEANUP_ON_MERGE, on by default): this script first,

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: then it ends the session and removes the worktree. A non-zero exit is only logged; manual cleanup runs it too.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: With cleanup on merge on, this switch on and a new merge seen this poll: after the cleanup scan, the resident

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: site is rebuilt and restarted in the background. Cleanup success is not required; with cleanup off it never runs.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Retrospectives are their own background queue, advanced every poll (POST_MERGE_RETROSPECTIVE, on by default).

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: This command runs before the retrospective commits; what it changes joins that commit, and a failure commits nothing.
